terms.definition: How much text a model can read in one call, counted in tokens. Bigger windows cost more per call and are emptied when the call ends.
The unit models read and bill by: roughly three-quarters of an English word.
Talking over a voice agent while it speaks. A good agent stops its audio, its text and any pending action at once.
An isolated space where code runs without access to your files, network or secrets unless you allow it.
A list of what is permitted; everything not on it is denied.
A model whose trained parameters you can download and run yourself, usually under a licence.
